title: Product pricing
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-07-01
html:
Prices on TikTok Shop are set at the SKU level. The allowable price range varies based on the destination market and the seller operation mode. Some markets also require specific currency precision. For Indonesia, Japan, and Vietnam, prices must be integers because these currencies do not support decimal places.

Notes

  • For Indonesia, Japan, and Vietnam, prices must be integers.
  • For Thailand, the minimum price is 30 for local sellers and sellers with local warehouses, and 0.01 for sellers with cross-border warehouses.
  • For Indonesia, a discounted price less than 2,000 IDR may lead to a negative balance.
